name: @adhd/sox-semantic
description: Semantic RAG composition layer — a DI facade that wires @adhd/sox-graph-store + @adhd/sox-vector-store + @adhd/sox-embedding-provider into a single embed/index/search/rank surface (createSemanticBackend), plus the embedding-lifecycle observer (embed-on-write, delete-on-invalidate). Owns the node-join; keeps graph-store and vector-store at their own tiers (ADR-0016).

concerns: createSemanticBackend — the ADR-0006 composer: DI-wires embedding-provider instance + graph/vector backends over the caller's StoreAdapter
SemanticBackend — async surface (embedQuery / embedDocuments / upsertVector(s) / deleteVector / semanticSearchNodes / health)
typed failure taxonomy (not_installed | provider_failed | unsupported_adapter | vector_store_failed), never a bare throw
semanticSearchNodes — the sole owner of the node-join (embed → knn → graph.queryNodes → ranked { node, score })
batch-first embeddings (embedDocuments + upsertVectors) — per-item error containment, never a placeholder vector
invariants: createSemanticBackend returns a typed result, never throws for a configurable failure (not_installed/provider_failed/unsupported_adapter/vector_store_failed)
a failed embed degrades the write, never corrupts it — no placeholder vectors, no rolled-back node write
score is cosine similarity (higher-is-better) on both turso (1 - vector_distance_cos) and sqlite (cosineSimilarity), stable across backends
live objects (open DB, provider instance, vector backend) cross into this package via DI over the caller's StoreAdapter — never a duplicated stateful bundle (ADR-0006)
